description: This is a Dart source file defining the TransactionsScreen widget for a Flutter application. It manages the display, addition, editing, and deletion of financial transactions, utilizing state management, navigation, and external repositories.

classes.name: TransactionsScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a list of transactions for a selected month, allowing users to add, edit, or delete transactions.

classes.name: _TransactionsScreenState
classes.description: State class for TransactionsScreen, managing the internal state such as selected date, loading status, transaction list, and category names.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state and loads transactions and categories for the current month.

methods.name: _load
methods.description: Fetches transactions for the selected month and category names from repositories and updates state.

methods.name: _addOrEdit
methods.description: Navigates to the AddTransactionScreen to add or edit a transaction, then reloads data.

methods.name: _delete
methods.description: Deletes a transaction by ID and refreshes the transaction list.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, including AppBar, FloatingActionButton, and ListView of transactions.
